result.summary: Lantern Utilities emailed to say an invoice was attached, but no attachment shows up on the ticket, so there's nothing to check against the approved £90 + VAT. I asked them to resend it as a PDF and confirm the hinge replacement was finished at the 30/09/2025 visit. I moved the ticket from scheduling to works and set a 2-day follow-up.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord approved the attendance (event 007) and then the hinge replacement at £90 + VAT (events 015, 016, 018). The visit was confirmed for 30/09/2025 (events 027–031). In event 041 the contractor says 'Attached invoice', but get_ticket_context lists no attachments, so the invoice can't be read or checked. Only the contractor can fix that, so asking them and setting a hold is the right next step. The classifier rated the email routine (auto, intent invoice).

alternatives_considered.why_not: Nothing is in dispute or in conflict. It's a missing attachment, and the contractor can sort it out.

alternatives_considered.option: Move to closeout or tell the landlord and tenant the work is done
alternatives_considered.why_not: Neither the contractor nor the tenant has confirmed the work is finished, and the invoice hasn't been seen.
The ticket would stall with no invoice to process and no hold set.
